<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/scenes"}

You can query a scene list by this API. A scene consists of actions and optional metadata; it has no starters, conditions, or enabled flag. The target ID for updates is in the body; success means the request was accepted. For batch operations, check the result of each item.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"in":"query","name":"sceneName","required":false,"description":"Fuzzy filter by scene name.","schema":{"type":"string"},"example":"Lights on when arriving home"},{"in":"query","name":"spaceIds","required":false,"description":"Whether to query scenes under the specified list of space IDs. Support comma separation or repeated parameters; any associated space hit, multiple IDs take union, only return once for the same object. totalCount is calculated after deduplication and before pagination. If omitted or empty, do not filter by specified space. Example: spaceIds=xx1,xx2 or spaceIds=xx1&spaceIds=xx2. Do not filter by specified space if empty.","schema":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"style":"form","explode":true},{"in":"query","name":"needChildren","required":false,"description":"Whether to include scenes from child spaces. Only takes effect when spaceIds is provided.","schema":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},{"in":"query","name":"spaceAssociated","required":false,"description":"When omitted, no space association filter is applied. True means the query of scenes associated with spaces. False means the query of scenes not associated with spaces. When spaceAssociated=false, spaceIds and needChildren are ignored.","schema":{"type":"boolean","nullable":true}},{"in":"query","name":"orderBy","required":false,"description":"Sort order","schema":{"type":"string","default":"createTime asc","enum":["createTime asc","createTime desc"]},"example":"createTime asc"},{"in":"query","name":"pageNum","required":false,"description":"Page number.","schema":{"type":"integer","default":1}},{"in":"query","name":"pageSize","required":false,"description":"Page size.","schema":{"type":"integer","default":200}},{"in":"query","name":"includeMetadata","required":false,"schema":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"description":"Whether to return the object's metadata."}]}
